findings.evidenceJa: 黒い極光
findings.governingReading: a black aurora
findings.explanation: The aurora image is replaced by an unsupported superlative description.

findings.evidenceJa: 砂の粒ほどの呪文の群れ
findings.governingReading: a swarm of incantations/spells as small as grains of sand
findings.explanation: Neutral spell language is changed into curses before the scene identifies the larger curse.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の体をくまなく浚っていき
findings.governingReading: swept/scoured every part of her body
findings.explanation: A sensation passing comprehensively over Saber becomes removal of her body.

findings.highlight: Skin that was protected by armor
findings.evidenceJa: 鎧で守られていなかった肌
findings.governingReading: the skin that had not been protected by armor
findings.explanation: The protection state is reversed.

findings.highlight: managed to offset it a bit with Excalibur
findings.evidenceJa: エクスカリバーでかろうじて相殺した
findings.governingReading: barely managed to cancel/offset it with Excalibur
findings.explanation: Marginal success becomes a small degree of cancellation.

findings.evidenceJa: 傷一つない甲冑と共に
findings.governingReading: approaches in armor without a single scratch
findings.explanation: An attribute of Gilgamesh’s armor is reassigned to his whole person.

findings.highlight: covered the earth for an instant
findings.evidenceJa: 一瞬だけ世界を覆った
findings.governingReading: covered the world for an instant
findings.explanation: The narrated scope changes from world to earth.

findings.evidenceJa: 極大の呪い
findings.governingReading: a curse of the greatest/maximal scale
findings.explanation: The explicit maximum scale is weakened.

findings.highlight: the remains of what came out of the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯から漏れている残りカス
findings.governingReading: mere dregs leaking from the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: Contemptuous dregs and ongoing leakage become generic remains.

findings.highlight: It is weak and ready to go out
findings.evidenceJa: 今にも消え去りそうな火
findings.governingReading: a weak flame on the verge of disappearing
findings.explanation: The connection is no longer figured as a nearly extinguished flame.

findings.evidenceJa: 四肢に力を込める
findings.governingReading: she puts strength into all four limbs
findings.explanation: The precise bodily effort becomes only its inferred goal.

findings.highlight: this ritual is for your benefit, not mine
findings.evidenceJa: 此度の儀は我ではなくおまえに与えられたもの
findings.governingReading: this rite on this occasion / written “I,” read with Gilgamesh’s ore voice
findings.explanation: The written diction and marked first-person reading disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 口元を吊り上げる
findings.governingReading: curls the corner of his mouth
findings.explanation: A predatory facial gesture becomes a generic smile.

findings.evidenceJa: 自我を保てる
findings.governingReading: retain your self/ego
findings.explanation: Loss of selfhood under the mud becomes ordinary sanity.

findings.highlight: a magnificent cluster of magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の束としては破格
findings.governingReading: exceptional/out of scale as a mass of magical energy
findings.explanation: An objective scale judgment becomes praise.

findings.highlight: If it were Caster using it, nothing would be impossible
findings.evidenceJa: おそらくキャスターであれば、それこそ不可能はなくなるだろう
findings.governingReading: If Caster had it, perhaps nothing would be impossible for her
findings.explanation: Saber’s explicitly marked conjecture is asserted as fact.

findings.highlight: looks abnormaland crazyand it suits him
findings.evidenceJa: 常軌を逸しているようでもありこの上なく、この男に相応しい貌
findings.governingReading: seems beyond the bounds of sanity, yet is a face supremely fitting for him
findings.explanation: The paradoxical evaluation is reduced to malformed generic adjectives.

findings.evidenceJa: 己が視界に入る全ての人間
findings.governingReading: every person who enters his field of vision
findings.explanation: The human beings a hero bears are broadened into all visible things.

findings.highlight: his selfishness to consider himself the greatest
findings.evidenceJa: 天地には我のみという強大な自我
findings.governingReading: the immense ego that proclaims there is only he under heaven
findings.explanation: A characterizing royal formulation becomes generic selfishness.

findings.highlight: his merciless nature that never thinks of others
findings.evidenceJa: 他者を省みぬ無慈悲な選定
findings.governingReading: his merciless selection that gives no thought to others
findings.explanation: A governing act of selection becomes an abstract personality trait.

findings.highlight: let us hold our marriage now
findings.evidenceJa: 今のうちに婚姻を決めておくか
findings.governingReading: shall I settle the marriage while there is time
findings.explanation: A coercive decision or arrangement becomes holding the marriage ceremony immediately.

findings.highlight: She does not say it to anyone
findings.evidenceJa: 誰に言い聞かせるでもなく
findings.governingReading: without trying to convince or remind anyone in particular
findings.explanation: The narration denies self-persuasion, not audible address.

findings.highlight: A country is just a possession
findings.evidenceJa: 王にとって、国とは己の物にすぎない
findings.governingReading: For a king, a country is nothing more than his own possession
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s king-centered ownership rule loses both its agent and reflexive possession.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の心は固まった
findings.governingReading: her resolve became firm
findings.explanation: A new crystallization of resolve is changed into recovery of an earlier state.

findings.highlight: stays upside-down and jumps using her arms
findings.evidenceJa: 逆立ちのまま体を反転させ、腕の力だけで大きく跳んだ
findings.governingReading: while inverted, she turns her body over and makes a great leap using only her arms
findings.explanation: The body reversal and scale of the leap disappear from the escape choreography.

findings.highlight: not the slightest chance of winning
findings.evidenceJa: 万に一つほどの勝算がなくとも
findings.governingReading: even without so much as a one-in-ten-thousand chance of victory
findings.explanation: A quantitative image of desperate odds becomes a generic absolute.

findings.highlight: the best range she found earlier
findings.evidenceJa: 先ほど身をもって体験した、最も迎撃に適した間合い
findings.governingReading: the range she had just learned with her own body was best for interception
findings.explanation: Bodily experience and the tactical purpose of interception disappear.

findings.highlight: the arms holding her sword are weak
findings.evidenceJa: 両腕は力さえ籠もらない
findings.governingReading: she cannot put even strength into either arm
findings.explanation: An inability to muster force becomes a general weakness.

findings.evidenceJa: 愛剣
findings.governingReading: her beloved/favored sword, read “Ea”
findings.explanation: The written epithet marking Gilgamesh’s attachment to the weapon is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 決死の覚悟
findings.governingReading: resolve prepared for death
findings.explanation: The mortal commitment in Saber’s gaze is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 覇王剣
findings.governingReading: the overlord king’s sword
findings.explanation: A royal title is replaced by the different technical epithet used for Ea.

findings.evidenceJa: 天地乖離す開闢の星
findings.governingReading: the Star of Creation that Split Heaven and Earth, read “Enuma Elish”
findings.explanation: The attack’s written meaning is omitted, leaving only its reading.

findings.highlight: she is swallowed by the light. The instant I am swallowed by the darkness
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は光の中に呑みこまれた。闇に呑まれた瞬間
findings.governingReading: she is swallowed by the light; the instant she is swallowed by darkness
findings.explanation: The English switches to Shirou’s first person before the source changes battle and viewpoint.

findings.highlight: Elimination of human rights by castration, oppression, exile, execution
findings.evidenceJa: 断首、追放、弾圧による人権排除
findings.governingReading: elimination of human rights through beheading, exile, and oppression
findings.explanation: Castration is inserted and the source’s beheading is split into a separate execution.

findings.evidenceJa: 自傷
findings.governingReading: self-harm
findings.explanation: A broader offense is narrowed to completed self-killing.

findings.evidenceJa: 暴虐
findings.governingReading: tyranny/atrocity
findings.explanation: Rape is inserted as an additional offense without source support.

findings.evidenceJa: 徳を得る為に冒す
findings.governingReading: transgress in order to gain virtue
findings.explanation: The object sought changes from virtue to social respect.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦痛と嫌悪
findings.governingReading: pain and disgust/aversion
findings.explanation: The curse’s inward revulsion becomes hatred.

findings.highlight: Blood flows through my beaten up body and makes it stand
findings.evidenceJa: 立ち上がる為の血が巡る
findings.governingReading: blood needed to stand again courses through his battered body
findings.explanation: Blood becomes the agent physically making the body stand.

findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: ally/champion of justice
findings.explanation: Shirou and Kiritsugu’s defining ethical phrase is recast as a genre label.

findings.highlight: could not get anyone’s permission for that
findings.evidenceJa: そんな許しなど誰からも得られず
findings.governingReading: could obtain no such forgiveness/absolution from anyone
findings.explanation: Moral forgiveness for Kiritsugu is reduced to authorization for his conduct.

findings.highlight: nodded to himself that everything was okay
findings.evidenceJa: 最期に、良かったなんて頷いた
findings.governingReading: at the end, nodded and said that he was glad
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s relieved final response is expanded into a judgment that everything was okay.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮切嗣の息子
findings.governingReading: written “Emiya Kiritsugu’s son,” read “ally of justice”
findings.explanation: The double identification binding Shirou’s filial identity to the ideal is collapsed and mispossessed.

findings.evidenceJa: 死んでも勝て
findings.governingReading: win even if you die
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit demand to accept death as the price of victory is omitted.

findings.highlight: I’m going to unravel from rage before being torn apart by the curse.  I’m going to go crazy from anger before I go crazy from the curse.
findings.evidenceJa: 呪いに引き裂かれる前に、この怒りでバラけそうだ
findings.governingReading: He feels he may come apart from this anger before the curse tears him apart.
findings.explanation: A second unsupported sentence repeats and simplifies the line as “going crazy.”

findings.evidenceJa: その短絡思考
findings.governingReading: that short-circuited/hasty line of thought
findings.explanation: Kotomine attacks Shirou’s immediate reasoning, not his general intelligence.

findings.evidenceJa: ずる、と音をたてて黒い塊を摘出する
findings.governingReading: extracts a black mass with a wet dragging sound
findings.explanation: The concrete sound and surgical extraction image are lost, while “another” is added.

findings.highlight: It’s the only proof I have
findings.evidenceJa: ほとんど死に体で、自分が生きているかさえ判らない俺が感じられる、ただ一つの証がそれだ
findings.governingReading: It is the sole proof perceptible even to him, nearly dead and unsure whether he is alive.
findings.explanation: The bodily extremity and meaning of the proof are entirely omitted.

findings.highlight: if I don’t greet her with open arms
findings.evidenceJa: 手をあげて迎えてやらないと
findings.governingReading: if he is not there to raise a hand and greet her
findings.explanation: A small characteristic gesture becomes an expansive embrace.

findings.highlight: My body melts from my fingertips.  …My body crumbles away from the tips.
findings.evidenceJa: 体が、先端から、崩れていく
findings.governingReading: His body crumbles from its extremities.
findings.explanation: The English inserts a separate melting sentence before translating the actual crumbling.

findings.evidenceJa: 天地乖離す開闢の星
findings.governingReading: the Star of Creation that Split Heaven and Earth, read “Enuma Elish”
findings.explanation: The attack’s written meaning is again omitted.

findings.highlight: a flash of light and a roar of wind
findings.evidenceJa: 目を潰す閃光、耳を覆う暴風
findings.governingReading: a blinding flash and a gale that covers the ears
findings.explanation: Specific assaults on sight and hearing become generic light and sound.

findings.highlight: That is a fact that cannot be changed
findings.evidenceJa: それは両者に共通した確信だった
findings.governingReading: That was a conviction shared by both of them.
findings.explanation: The combatants’ belief is promoted into immutable objective fact just before the narration overturns it.

findings.evidenceJa: 約束された勝利の剣
findings.governingReading: the Sword of Promised Victory, read “Excalibur”
findings.explanation: The Noble Phantasm’s written meaning is omitted.

findings.highlight: she can only push back just a little
findings.evidenceJa: 押し返せるのはわずか一足
findings.governingReading: she can push it back only the distance of a single step
findings.explanation: A decisive spatial measure becomes vague degree.

findings.evidenceJa: エアを振り抜き
findings.governingReading: having swung Ea all the way through
findings.explanation: The weapon’s completed follow-through becomes preparation.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの体が駆けた
findings.governingReading: Saber’s body dashes forward
findings.explanation: The final ground-closing action changes from a dash to a jump.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou will be eliminated from the outside
findings.evidenceJa: 外側からまるごと消されていくのか
findings.governingReading: Is he being erased whole from the outside inward?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s immediate fearful inference is asserted as narration.

findings.evidenceJa: 悪魔めいた速度
findings.governingReading: demonic speed
findings.explanation: A charged comparison becomes generic incredulity.

findings.evidenceJa: 胸に刻み込んだもの
findings.governingReading: engraved into his chest/heart
findings.explanation: The locus tying the shape to Shirou’s inner self is generalized.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎の半身故
findings.governingReading: because it is Emiya Shirou’s other half
findings.explanation: An identity relation becomes a literal bodily component.

findings.highlight: The arm reaching out still moves
findings.evidenceJa: 懸命に伸ばした指先が、まだ動く
findings.governingReading: The desperately extended fingertips still move.
findings.explanation: Fine remaining motion at Shirou’s extremity becomes movement of the whole arm.

findings.evidenceJa: 作り上げたそのカタチ
findings.governingReading: the shape he created
findings.explanation: The narration withholds the object’s identity until later in the sentence; the English names it early.

findings.highlight: With Ea straight ahead of her
findings.evidenceJa: エアの断層を前にして
findings.governingReading: before the spatial rift made by Ea
findings.explanation: The threat is the rift Ea creates, not the sword’s position.

findings.highlight: No one knows what kind of a divine mystery it is made from
findings.evidenceJa: 如何なる神秘で編まれたものか
findings.governingReading: By whatever mystery the sheath may have been woven
findings.explanation: A rhetorical expression of wonder becomes a universal claim about knowledge.

findings.highlight: blocked off from all matter in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この世の全ての理から断絶される
findings.governingReading: cut off from every law/principle of this world
findings.explanation: Metaphysical separation from the world’s laws becomes separation from physical matter.

findings.evidenceJa: 全て遠き理想郷
findings.governingReading: The Ever-Distant Utopia / Avalon
findings.explanation: The grammatical relation of the written Noble Phantasm title is mangled.

findings.highlight: the death running up his spine
findings.evidenceJa: 背筋に走る死神
findings.governingReading: the god/specter of death racing up his spine
findings.explanation: The personified death image is flattened.

findings.evidenceJa: 振り下げたエア
findings.governingReading: Ea, already swung downward
findings.explanation: The weapon’s phase of motion is reversed.

findings.evidenceJa: 駆け抜ける青い衣
findings.governingReading: a blue-clad figure races through
findings.explanation: Saber is reduced to independently running clothes.

findings.evidenceJa: 投影魔術
findings.governingReading: Projection magecraft
findings.explanation: The named magecraft category is shortened to the generic act.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou runs on his hands as well
findings.evidenceJa: 両腕で地を弾いて、衛宮士郎は疾走した
findings.governingReading: Shirou strikes/pushes off the ground with both arms and sprints
findings.explanation: A push-off during a fall becomes quadrupedal running.

findings.evidenceJa: 地を這う姿勢のまま
findings.governingReading: in a posture skimming/crawling along the ground
findings.explanation: The extremity of Shirou’s low posture is weakened.

findings.highlight: Stopping himself with his feet, Emiya Shirou jumps back.  Wind comes down.  The priest turns to face the enemy who stabbed him.  At the same time, two impacts pierce Kotomine Kirei. back
findings.evidenceJa: 片足で地面に杭を打ち、走り抜いた勢いのまま身を翻し
findings.governingReading: He plants one foot like a stake and pivots with the momentum of his run.
findings.explanation: The active pivot is replaced by a retreat and several unsupported, malformed action sentences.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の頬を指でなぞる
findings.governingReading: traces her cheek with a finger
findings.explanation: A deliberate final tracing gesture becomes generic contact.

findings.highlight: The existence of the king of heroes is disappearing
findings.evidenceJa: 血を流し、肉の感触を持っていた英雄王の存在が消えていく
findings.governingReading: the Heroic King’s existence, which had bled and possessed the feel of flesh, fades away
findings.explanation: The bodily signs of Gilgamesh’s incarnation are omitted at his death.

findings.evidenceJa: 不機嫌に舌を鳴らす
findings.governingReading: He clicks his tongue in displeasure.
findings.explanation: A physical sound and gesture becomes a speech manner adverb.

findings.evidenceJa: 青白い火花
findings.governingReading: pale blue sparks
findings.explanation: The sparks’ distinctive color is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 頭上の『孔』
findings.governingReading: the “hole” above
findings.explanation: A concrete opening is changed into an abstract void.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂から預かったものだ
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka entrusted it to me / I am holding it for her
findings.explanation: Rin’s deliberate entrustment becomes Shirou borrowing the dagger.

findings.highlight: the body that he hasn’t moved since the beginning of our confrontation finally moves
findings.evidenceJa: 体を、ぐらりと揺らした
findings.governingReading: his body gives a heavy sway
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s loss of balance is generalized into mere motion.

findings.evidenceJa: 今まで使役していたモノ
findings.governingReading: the thing he had controlled/used until now
findings.explanation: Kotomine’s sustained command over the mud becomes only its summoning.
